items.title: NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC memorandum, Insider Sport reports
items.content_text: - **NBA names Kalshi and Polymarket preferred prediction market exchanges and signs CFTC memorandum, Insider Sport reports** — The NBA has named Kalshi and Polymarket its preferred prediction market exchanges and expanded its agreement with DraftKings to cover prediction markets, giving the exchanges NBA intellectual property, marketing rights and Sportradar data. items.title: CFTC sues Utah to block state effort to shut down prediction markets, FX News Group reports
items.content_text: - **CFTC sues Utah to block state effort to shut down prediction markets, FX News Group reports** — The CFTC said it filed suit against Utah to block the state from using state laws to shut down CFTC-registered contract markets, after Utah filed civil enforcement actions in state court. Chair Michael Selig said Congress entrusted the CFTC with sole responsibility to oversee these markets and that event contracts provide information about the outcome of future events. items.content_text: - **Brennan Center study finds prediction market odds sway voters and most want tighter regulation** — A Brennan Center-funded study of 1,994 registered voters conducted September 21 found voters were 10 to 20 percentage points more likely to pick a candidate favored by prediction markets, regardless of polling. items.title: Polymarket US sets record with more than 74 million October trades as active traders reach about 478,000, CryptoNews reports
items.content_text: - **Polymarket US sets record with more than 74 million October trades as active traders reach about 478,000, CryptoNews reports** — CryptoNews reports Polymarket US processed more than 74 million trades in October, up 15 percent from September, driven by expanded NFL and college football markets and bundled contracts introduced in August that exceeded half of activity in some weeks. Monthly active traders reached a record of about 478,000, and the platform recorded 2.82 billion dollars in notional volume in one week during the month. ([CryptoNews](https://cryptonews.net/news/market/33652973/))
